evidence.title: Six ways parents could make the return to school a little easier

occurrences.checkable_against: Cerys Parker's interview or published description of her family calendar
occurrences.quote_span: It's an academic year calendar with a space for each of us, and then an events section, so as soon as a notice comes in, I write it down.

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: "Ask some open questions, instead of interrogating them," he says.
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview or published back-to-school guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Shield adds that you don't want to overwhelm your child with information about school, but get them to a point where it feels "familiar"
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Cerys Parker's interview or account of school-day departures
occurrences.quote_span: She grabs their lunch boxes and they leave the house at 07:30 for the bus, or 07:50 if Parker is dropping them at school on the way to her own job.
occurrences.speaker: Cerys Parker
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Shield says parents should "reassure themselves" about the routine they will need to follow on school mornings.
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Katharine Radice's interview or statement about homework timetables
occurrences.quote_span: "Doing this puts boundaries around homework and makes it easier to ring-fence distraction-free time," she says.
occurrences.speaker: Katharine Radice
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview or guidance and NHS/local GP advice
occurrences.quote_span: If anxiety does become overwhelming for them, if they aren't sleeping or it is stopping them from doing everyday things, then Shield recommends talking to the school or a local GP.
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview or comparative child-questioning research
occurrences.quote_span: These sorts of questions are a lot easier to answer for a child, he says, instead of asking what they did.
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Katharine Radice's interview or published homework guidance
occurrences.quote_span: She also recommends looking for opportunities to praise your child's effort in doing work to help them "stay motivated."
occurrences.speaker: Katharine Radice
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Martha Deiros Collado's interview or statement about school readiness
occurrences.quote_span: Building independence can also help bridge the gap between home and school life, she says, by encouraging your child to do some things by themselves, such as zipping up their own coat.
occurrences.speaker: Martha Deiros Collado
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview or child-anxiety guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Some children who are returning to school may have anxieties about the year ahead, and Shield recommends to sit with your child and listen to their concerns.
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: World Book Day 2027 official calendar
occurrences.quote_span: World Book Day, on Thursday, 4 March 2027
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.checkable_against: Will Shield's interview or published back-to-school guidance
occurrences.quote_span: He also encourages parents to introduce their child into the concept of school, through things like: Reading books about school Going through the school website Trying on the new school uniform or PE kit
occurrences.speaker: Will Shield
occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance

occurrences.subject: back-to-school preparation guidance
